pr_title: test_runner: run before hook immediately if test started
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/nodejs/node/issues/51371

instead of the [previous fix](https://github.com/nodejs/node/pull/51389) not running hooks when no tests, 
this makes sure before and after hooks run regardless of the existence of subtests

issue_context.title: test_runner: after() hook is called  for no subtests

review_comments:

2. ~Why did you need to add it here and the one in the run is not enough?~, because the hooks that are running in the run function are the parent hooks
